title: 第13章 野丫头李翠翠第14章 大姨妈来了
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
“谁说我打不过，我那天在王彩霞家里，把猴子那帮地痞无赖打的落花流水，难道你忘了？”赵大柱没好气的说道。
李翠翠愣了愣便惊喜的叫道：“对对对，赵大爷你现在这么厉害，肯定能赶走这头野猪……我刚刚只是脑子没转过弯，赵大爷你别生气，你快帮帮我！”
“这才像话！”
赵大柱说着就撸起胳膊上的衣服袖子，朝着那头野猪冲了过去。
而那头将近两百斤的野猪，一下子就被赵大柱激怒了，发出哼哼哼的猪叫声并冲了过来。
碰！
一人一猪撞在一起，地面好像都随之颤抖了一下，周围的树木也跟着震颤。
几十片绿油油的树叶从上方的树冠掉落下来，纷纷扬扬，仿佛下起了一场叶雨。
下一秒，赵大柱就低吼着抱起这头野猪，来了一个重重的过肩摔！
野猪狠狠砸在地上的瞬间就激起一大团烟尘，这头野猪更是发出了撕心裂肺的猪叫，就跟杀年猪似的。
“哎哟我的妈呀！这，这这这……”
树上的李翠翠都惊呆了，一张樱桃小嘴张的大大的。
“还要打吗，畜生！”
赵大柱转过身发出一声厉喝，而这头将近两百斤的野猪明显已经怕了。
它挣扎着猪叫着，从地上爬起以后就跌跌撞撞的朝着远处跑去，几个呼吸的功夫就钻进林子里看不见了。
危险解除，李翠翠立即就从树上往下爬。
而且她一边往下爬还一边大叫：
“赵大爷你怎么这么猛啊，那头野猪又大又肥，少说也有两百斤了吧？就算没有两百斤也肯定有一百八了，你居然能给它来一个过肩摔？”
“你你你……你到底是怎么办到的？你该不会是电影里演的那什么力王吧！”
“傻妮子，说啥呢！”

赵大柱转身看向李翠翠，瞪着眼睛说道：“说王不说吧，文明你我他。”
“嘿嘿，赵大爷你可真幽默。”
说话间，李翠翠就从树上爬下来了。
她一路小跑的来到赵大柱的面前，好奇的上上下下打量眼前这个五十多岁的老头子。
赵大柱头发斑白，脸上还有许多皱纹，尤其是眼角的鱼尾纹，深的都能夹死苍蝇了。
而且赵大柱的脸上还有些许老年斑，甚至手上也有。
他身上的衣服也是普普通通，土里土气的。
这样一个老头，不管从哪个角度看都是那么的平凡，每个乡村都随处可见。
可他怎么就那么厉害，能把一头将近两百斤的野猪过肩摔呢？
李翠翠实在是想不通，她觉得自己的脑子不够用了。
“看什么呢？”赵大柱问道。
“我看你呀，赵大爷你到底怎么练的，力气居然那么大，我以前怎么没发现你这么厉害？”
李翠翠忍不住说道。
“因为我以前很低调。”赵大柱说道。
“那你现在怎么不低调了？”李翠翠又问。
“因为我忽然觉得，做人太低调了就会被别人瞧不起，甚至被人家欺负。所以我想改变一下风格，我想让那些狗东西知道我不是好惹的。”
赵大柱哼了一声说道。
“赵大爷，你说的狗东西指的是村长对不对？”李翠翠笑个不停。
“我可没这么说。”赵大柱摇头。
content_en:
"Who says I can't beat him? That day at Wang Caixia's house, I beat the monkey gang to a pulp. Have you forgotten?" Zhao Dazhu said angrily.
Li Cuicui was stunned for a moment and then shouted in surprise: "Yes, yes, Uncle Zhao, you are so powerful now, you will definitely be able to drive away this wild boar... I just didn't know what to do. Uncle Zhao, don't be angry, please help me!"
"This is so true!"
As Zhao Dazhu spoke, he rolled up the sleeves on his arms and rushed towards the wild boar.
The wild boar, which weighed nearly two hundred kilograms, was immediately angered by Zhao Dazhu. It made a roaring sound and rushed over.
bump!
A man and a pig collided with each other, and the ground seemed to tremble, and the surrounding trees also trembled.
Dozens of green leaves fell from the canopy above, flying one after another, as if there was a leaf rain.
The next second, Zhao Dazhu roared, picked up the wild boar, and threw it heavily over his shoulder!
The moment the wild boar hit the ground hard, a large cloud of smoke and dust was stirred up. The wild boar even let out a heart-rending roar, as if it was killing a New Year pig.
"Oh my god! This, this, this, this..."
Li Cuicui on the tree was stunned, her little cherry mouth opened wide.
"Do you want to fight again, you beast!"
Zhao Dazhu turned around and let out a sharp shout, but the nearly two hundred kilogram wild boar was obviously scared.
It struggled and squealed. After getting up from the ground, it stumbled and ran towards the distance. In just a few breaths, it slipped into the forest and disappeared from sight.
When the danger was over, Li Cuicui immediately climbed down from the tree.
And as she climbed down, she yelled:
"Uncle Zhao, why are you so fierce? That wild boar is big and fat. It weighs at least two hundred kilograms, right? Even if it doesn't weigh two hundred kilograms, it must weigh one hundred and eighty. How can you actually throw it over your shoulder?"
"You, you, you...how did you do it? You can't be the King of Power you play in the movie, are you?"
"Silly girl, what are you talking about!"
Zhao Dazhu turned to look at Li Cuicui, glared and said, "Don't tell me the king, you and I are civilized."
"Hey, Uncle Zhao, you are so funny."
While talking, Li Cuicui climbed down from the tree.
She trotted all the way to Zhao Dazhu, curiously looking up and down at the fifty-year-old man in front of her.
Zhao Dazhu has gray hair and many wrinkles on his face, especially the crow's feet at the corners of his eyes, which are so deep they could trap a fly.
Moreover, Zhao Dazhu still has some age spots on his face and even on his hands.
The clothes he wore were ordinary and rustic.
Such an old man looks so ordinary no matter from any angle, and can be seen everywhere in every village.
But how could he be so powerful that he could throw a nearly two hundred kilogram wild boar over his shoulder?
Li Cuicui really couldn't figure it out. She felt that her brain was not used enough.
"What are you looking at?" Zhao Dazhu asked.
"Look at you, Uncle Zhao, how did you practice and become so strong? Why didn't I realize you were so powerful before?"
Li Cuicui couldn't help but said.
"Because I used to be very low-key." Zhao Dazhu said.
"Then why don't you keep a low profile now?" Li Cuicui asked again.
"Because I suddenly felt that if I were too low-key, I would be looked down upon by others, or even bullied by others. So I wanted to change my style. I wanted those bitches to know that I am not someone to be trifled with."
Zhao Dazhu said with a snort.
"Uncle Zhao, the shit you're talking about is the village chief, right?" Li Cuicui couldn't stop laughing.
"I didn't say that." Zhao Dazhu shook his head.
